notes.title: We’re excited to announce the release date for Mr.Billion — July 31st!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce the release date for Mr.Billion — the game launches on July 31st![/p][p][/p][p]The demo version of Mr.Billion received a ton of valuable feedback from players — and we’re incredibly grateful for it. You told us what worked, what didn’t, and what could be improved. And we listened.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve fixed bugs, rebalanced the gameplay, and added new features — all based on your input. Now we’re ready to take the next big step.[/p][p][/p][p]🎉 Mr.Billion releases on July 31st![/p][p]Mark your calendars and get ready to build your way to billions.[/p][p][/p][p]🛒 Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607490/Mr_Billion_Idle_Rich_Tycoon"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Build Your Empire: Mr.Billion Steam Page Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621355/6b5ab3f636c3d3b540aa918bf084716d8836fbef.png[/img]
Hey there!

We’re excited to introduce our new game — Mr.Billion! The release on Steam in 2025!

Mr.Billion is a life simulator where you start from scratch and work your way up to billions, building a business empire. Make key choices, upgrade skills, and rise to become the richest person alive!

Career, family, luxury apartments, or even a private island — it’s all possible in the game! Become a billionaire and enjoy every step of your journey to success!

Want to chat with other future billionaires and share your thoughts about the game? [url=https://discord.gg/6dbPmFYjUf]Join our Discord server[/url]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607490/Mr_Billion_Idle_Rich_Tycoon?utm_source=Steam&utm_term=PageRelease]Add Mr.Billion to your Steam wishlist [/url]and follow our social media for exclusive updates!

See you in Mr.Billion!
